critical_code_review_comments: plugin_config.py:185 — `await csv_file.read()` reads full body before enforcing the 2MB cap. A malicious upload of e.g. 50MB briefly spikes memory before rejection. Consider streaming size guard or FastAPI/uvicorn max_body_size limit (same pattern as face upload).

plugin_config.py:144 — header detection triggers on any first-column string containing 'plate/plaque/immatriculation'. A first data-row like 'PLATE-123' (unlikely but possible) could be swallowed as header. Consider a strict exact-match on the whole cell.

plugin_config.py:209 — the retro-application `db.plates.update_many({'plate': row['plate']}, {'$set':{'list_status': ...}})` will overwrite list_status on ALL historical reads even those pre-import; documented behaviour but worth logging count for auditing.

auth.py:131 — query-param token fallback is convenient for <a href> exports but the token then appears in server access logs. Confirm access logs are not shipped to third-parties, otherwise consider signed short-lived download tokens.

PluginPage.jsx:389 — `encodeURIComponent(localStorage.getItem('mg_token') || '')` embeds JWT in URL used as href. Same log-leakage risk as backend note; acceptable but worth a short-lived download-token endpoint in future.
